findings.correctionCriterion: Inventory the actual rendered lesson-objective unit, including its associated 'In this chapter' label, under a frozen requirement appropriate to its learner-facing entry-point role. Include its actual reading-order and isolation relationship, then obtain fresh review coverage and an assessment of the resulting inventory's completeness. A semantically grouped label and objective is acceptable; do not add unrelated context or require redundant standalone wording.
